notes: Only what the renderer uses is shipped. Heights were integrated from the source normal maps (FFT) and are used through a box-projected Bump node, so they need no UVs or tangents. tile_mm and height_mm have no physical reference in the source files: they are estimates.

materials.label: 粗颗粒纹理
materials.use_when: 注塑工具箱、喷塑钢箱柜、手柄防滑区等带颗粒的哑光表面
materials.avoid_when: 亮面喷漆、亮面塑料、金属件、玻璃/透明件、橡胶、小于 30 mm 的部件、标签与印字区域、缩略图与预览
materials.source: user texture pack 2.jpg (= tex/1.jpg = 3.jpg), DirectX normal map; integrated to height, made seamless by a variance-preserving crossfade (seam ratio 1.62 -> 1.02)

materials.label: 红色反光膜

materials.avoid_when: 默认不用；材质规则从不自动选择
materials.source: user texture pack 2.png (prismatic retroreflective sheeting), cropped to 11x18 lattice periods and crossfaded
